description:
H200 26'' Adult Mountain Bike

Aluminum Frame - Light, sturdy, durable and more speedy.
Dual Disc Brakes - Fully ensure the safety of the ride.

Aluminum Suspension Fork - Smoother and more efficient riding experience.
Professional Drivetrain - Provides precise, fast and varied shifting.

Sturdy and Comfortable

Hiland H200 features a durable, ultralight and preservative aluminum frame which is perfect for exploring mountain trails in safety and comfort.

Internal shift cable and brake hose routing can help your cables last longer by protecting them from any environment, reduce wind resistance.

Reliable Brakes

Dual mechanical disc brakes ensure full control in every situation, allowing riders to stop quickly in case of an emergency.

Also, it does not damage the rim. It provides you better durability and stopping power.

Professional Drivetrain

SHIMANO 21-speed drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting with a wide range of gearing, so you always have the right gear for your terrain to enjoy riding.

Front suspension fork absorbs any bumps and dips encountered on your path, thus it can effectively reduce the obstructive shock during a ride, thus ensuring that you have an ideal comfortable riding experience.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes. NO KICKSTAND. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

Shimano Drivetrain

Shimano 21-speed drivetrain offers a wide gear range, giving you more control on climbs and more room for lower speeds on descents, corners and jumps.

Aluminum Frame

Hiland H200 features a lightweight and durable aluminum frame which helps you save pedal effort and ride faster.

Dual Disc Brakes

Dual disc brakes can provide a better braking effect and less affect in rainy days to ensure your safety. Also, it does not damage the rim.

Double Aluminum Wheel Rim

XC tires are thin and roll fast, have anti-skid patterns, handle pavement, gravel and dirt with ease.

Elevate your trail riding with the Hiland H200 Mountain Bike. Featuring a 21-speed drivetrain, lock-out suspension fork, and dual mechanical disc brakes for ultimate control and precision.
